note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(志愿服务主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文2-3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: When Leo first joined the city clean-up team, he thought one person could never change a whole neighbourhood. Yet he kept turning up every Saturday, picking up litter and planting flowers along the streets. A year later, his neighbours had joined him too, and the once-dirty park had become the pride of the area.

questions.q: What did Leo think when he first joined the team?
options: That one person could not change the neighbourhood.
That the work would be easy and quick.
That nobody else would ever help him.
That the park was already beautiful.
questions.explanation: 原文开头他觉得一个人改变不了整个社区的转述;其余选项与原文不符或未提。

questions.q: What had happened a year later?
options: Leo gave up and left the team.
Neighbours joined him and the park improved greatly.
The park became dirtier than before.
The city closed the clean-up team.
questions.explanation: 末句邻居加入、公园变成骄傲的转述(覆盖短文后半段)。
